# 0.16.0 — 19 October 2026

Minor release. `pip install opentide` is now the only install: every optional extra is gone, and every vendor SDK is part of the base install. After upgrading, do two things. Regenerate your CI pipeline, which picks up a security fix. Then regenerate your schemas, so the editor offers the ATT&CK 20.0 techniques.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.16.0
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide setup ci <github|gitlab|azure> --yes
opentide generate schemas
opentide validate --strict
```

## Highlights

- **One install, every platform.** Before this release, generated pipelines installed `opentide==<version>` with no extras. Live Sentinel query validation then failed with `needs a vendor SDK: No module named 'azure'`, so staging and production never deployed. The vendor SDKs now ship with `pip install opentide`. An old `pip install 'opentide[sentinel]'` still works, with a warning about the unknown extra ([#576](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/576)). Sentinel deploys through the ARM REST API directly, and the request bodies are unchanged.
- **Security: generated pipelines take tenant configuration from the default branch.** Live query validation and the staging deploy now use the default branch's `.opentide/configurations`. Before, they used the pull request's copy, so a pull request could send platform credentials to a host it chose ([#565](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/pull/565)). Regenerate your pipeline.
- **ATT&CK 20.0.** Techniques are pinned at `att&ck::1.2`, and 19.2 is restored at `att&ck::1.1`, so T1685–T1690, T1059.013 and the other v18/v19 techniques validate again. Elastic and Sentinel tactics follow ATT&CK's split of Defense Evasion into Stealth and Defense Impairment ([#568](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/568)).
- **`generate` fails when a phase fails.** A phase that raises an error, or logs one, now exits `1`, names the phase and the object, and prints one JSON document instead of a traceback ([#579](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/579)).
- **New:** `opentide --version` ([#187](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/187)). Lint findings now carry `uuid`, `severity` and `yaml_line` ([#488](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/488)). `opentide setup platforms --elastic` is added ([#414](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/414)). A `platform_not_enabled` warning flags imported rule blocks for platforms you have not enabled ([#413](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/413)).
- **Fixes:**
  - Sentinel NRT import ([#577](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/577)).
  - Elastic deploy and live validation ([#557](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/557)), plus related Elastic, Splunk and duration fixes ([#558](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/558)–[#567](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/567)).
  - SDK validation of `rule::1.1` ([#582](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/582)).
  - Sharing of promoted rules ([#583](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/583)).
  - Navigator layer order ([#521](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/521)).
  - `migrate objects` on macOS and Windows ([#522](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/522)).

Thanks to @jonny-mcc for the Elastic, Splunk and duration fixes.

## Check after upgrading

- `opentide generate` exits `1` when a phase logs an error. A malformed object file now stops the run, where it used to be skipped. Run `opentide validate` to list every broken object.
- A missing or unknown `metadata.schema` fails validation. It is no longer checked against the newest revision.
- The first `generate exports navigator` after upgrading rewrites the layer once, in its new fixed order.
- Human `opentide lint` lines read `[check/severity] path[:line]: message`.

## Verify

```bash
pip install opentide==0.16.0
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"   # 0.16.0
opentide --version                                        # opentide 0.16.0
```
